profile.availability: Actively creating AI-powered tools that help individuals work smarter.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I’m a full-stack software engineer with experience building end-to-end applications using JavaScript, Python, and PHP. I focus on creating reliable, scalable solutions and enjoy working across both frontend and backend systems.

Recently, I have been building AI applications focused on creating simple, practical, and useful solutions using artificial intelligence. I work on these projects to better understand how AI can be applied to real-world problems, while continuously improving my technical skills and adapting to new technologies. Through hands-on development, I am learning how to design, build, and improve AI-driven systems that can provide real value to users.
